scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shared,backend,frontend "npm run dev -w @trasolve/shared" "npm run dev -w @trasolve/backend" "npm run dev -w @trasolve/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @trasolve/shared && npm run build -w @trasolve/backend && npm run build -w @trasolve/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @trasolve/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
